verdict.rationale: Hands-on probes confirm Cline publishes a live llms.txt at docs.cline.bot/llms.txt that indexes its documentation. Doc pages are also served as raw Markdown (.md) with a header telling agents to fetch the llms.txt index, so an agent can be pointed directly at agent-oriented docs. Missing for 10: first-party documentation describing or promoting the llms.txt/agent-docs offering (e.g., an llms-full.txt variant or usage guidance).
